title: Correctness validation: reconcile Usage Insights totals vs billing hooks (with tolerance + drift debugging)
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Goal
Ensure the Usage Insights breakdown totals (route + model rollups) reconcile with Billing totals derived from billing hooks for the same workspace/time window, within an agreed tolerance. Provide automated tests + a scheduled reconciliation job with actionable diffs.

Why this matters
- Beta/GA gate: customers will not trust insights unless totals align with invoices.
- Support load: we already have early discrepancy reports during beta (see SUP-24811).
- Finance/FinOps workflows: exports must match billing within a predictable tolerance and documented caveats.

Scope
1) Reconciliation suite (CI + scheduled job)
- Compare:
  A) Sum(usage_insights_agg.cost_usd) grouped by workspace + day/hour
  vs
  B) Sum(billing_hook_events.amount_usd) for same workspace + time window
- Output: pass/fail + diff report with top contributors.
- Run modes:
  - CI: deterministic fixture-based tests + limited integration test against staging warehouse snapshots.
  - Prod scheduled job: daily reconciliation for last N days (suggest N=7), plus an on-demand "reconcile range" admin endpoint.

2) Tolerance policy
- Default tolerance: max(0.5%, $2.00) per workspace per day (tune based on observed drift).
- Hard fail thresholds:
  - > 1.5% and > $10 for any workspace-day => page on-call (after beta only; for beta: Slack alert + issue).
- Track known sources of differences:
  - Rounding differences (per-request rounding vs aggregate rounding)
  - Late-arriving metering events (aggregation lag)
  - Retries counted differently between billing hooks vs telemetry attribution
  - Fallbacks / model alias bucketing leading to double-count/under-count
  - Streaming endpoints missing route tags in some regions (see Slack eng-platform/1738527701)

3) "Explain the diff" breakdown
When diff exceeds tolerance, generate a report including:
- Workspace, environment (if available), region, deployment mode, time bucket
- Billing total vs insights total
- Estimated breakdown of where drift might be coming from:
  - % of events missing route_tag
  - % of events with model_alias != canonical
  - Share of cost from retries/fallbacks
  - Late events count and max lateness
- Provide links to relevant dashboards and raw query snippets.

Acceptance criteria
- For staging + at least 3 beta workspaces in prod, reconciliation passes within tolerance for 7 consecutive days (excluding documented known incidents).
- CI tests cover:
  - Rounding edge cases (per-request micro-cost rounding)
  - Timezone and bucket boundary (UTC vs workspace timezone should not change totals)
  - Retry semantics (what counts as a billable retry vs a transport retry)
  - Fallback attribution (original model vs served model cost attribution)
- Scheduled reconciliation job runs daily and posts summary to #eng-platform (beta) with:
  - pass rate
  - worst offenders (top 5 diffs)
  - links to saved queries
- Support playbook snippet added: how to interpret common mismatch causes + required fields to request from customer.

Implementation notes
- Source of truth for billing totals: billing_hook_events (or equivalent) that finance uses for invoices. Do NOT compare against the Console query service output to avoid circular validation.
- Align time windowing:
  - Use event_timestamp_utc for both, and compare in UTC buckets first.
  - Separately compute "customer-view" bucket using workspace timezone, but reconciliation should be UTC-based.
- Rounding policy proposal:
  - Compute cost at highest available precision (micro-USD) throughout pipelines.
  - Only round at presentation/export boundaries.
  - If billing hooks are stored at cent precision, convert insights sums to cents using banker’s rounding at the bucket level (documented).

Open questions
- What is the canonical definition of "retry" for reconciliation?
  - Billing may include client retries if charged; telemetry may attribute to route/model multiple times.
  - Proposal: define a shared field billable_request_id that billing hooks and telemetry both emit; reconcile on that join where possible.
- Backfill window: if we backfill historical insights aggregates, should we exempt first 48 hours due to recompute churn?

References / links
- GitHub: PR for reconciliation suite + scheduled job: sources/github/redwood/pr-23166-reconciliation-tests-vs-billing-totals.json
- Slack (correctness): sources/slack/eng/1737582207.json
- Slack (missing route tags): sources/slack/eng-platform/1738527701.json
- SRE asks for thresholds/runbook: sources/slack/eng-sre/1737902255.json
- Support ticket: sources/jira/customer-support/SUP-24811-usage-insights-total-does-not-match-invoice.json

Rollout plan
- Beta: run reconciliation in "alert-only" mode; do not page. Create Linear follow-ups for recurring offenders.
- GA: switch to paging for sustained > threshold diffs; publish documented tolerance policy in help center and internal AE/SE FAQ.
comments: 2026-01-10 (Dylan Brooks): Marking as P0 for beta. Customers will compare CSV totals to invoice immediately. Please treat as GA gate even if we initially run alert-only.

2026-01-14 (Cole Summers): Aligned with Nadia: billing hooks store amount_usd at 1e-6 precision (micro-USD) in warehouse, invoices roll to cents at final step. Recommendation: keep reconciliation at micro-USD; only convert to cents for human-readable diffs.

2026-01-18 (Mei Lin): Found time window mismatch in earlier prototype: insights agg uses request_end_time; billing uses request_start_time. For long streams crossing hour boundaries, this can shift between buckets. Suggest reconcile on day-level first, then investigate hour-level drift as secondary signal.

2026-01-23 (Thomas Baird): Late events: current aggregation job allows 36h lateness; billing hooks are effectively real-time but can also arrive late during regional queue backpressure. Reconciliation job should exclude the last 6 hours by default to avoid noisy alerts.
2026-01-29 (Felix Schneider): Added saved query templates + diff report format to PR-23166. Still need clear policy for retry counting—blocked on definition from Nadia/Cole.

2026-02-04 (Nadia Rahman): Retry semantics proposal: count each billable attempt (billing_attempt_id) as separate cost. Telemetry attribution should emit billing_attempt_id; aggregation should group by billing_attempt_id to avoid double-count during retried tool calls. Filing follow-up if additional instrumentation needed.

2026-02-11 (Allison Grant): Please add alert suppression during known incident windows (e.g., ingestion lag) and include freshness lag in the reconciliation output so on-call can quickly distinguish real mismatch vs partial data.

2026-02-18 (Cole Summers): PR-23166 ready for review. Staging results: 0.18% median diff, worst 0.62% on a workspace with heavy streaming. Root cause: bucket boundary for long streams + missing route tags in eu-west on /v1/chat/completions streaming. This ticket should be considered done once missing route tags fix is deployed + we confirm 7-day pass window.
